Desmos calculators are available on the PSAT™8/9&10, PSAT/NMSQT
®, SAT
®, and AP
® Exams. The calculators you’ll see on
your exam may differ from what’s available for free on desmos.com.
Four-Function and Scientific Calculators:
The Four-Function and Scientific Calculators do not differ from the ones on desmos.com.
Graphing Calculator:
Images, folders, and notes Images, folders, and notes are disabled on your test.
Log mode for regressions The calculator on your test automatically checks Log mode when working with
applicable exponential, logarithmic, and power regressions.

In Bluebook, exams that have both the Scientific and Graphing Calculators will allow you to toggle between them.
Scientific Graphing
If you’d like to practice using the testing versions of the calculators, which are configured with the listed changes, visit our  
Testing page. All Desmos calculators are designed to be accessible to students with low vision or who are blind. For more
information, visit our Accessibilitypage.
